+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/output/trajectory")

+robot = Robot()
+print(json.dumps({"connected": True, "spec": robot.spec()}), flush=True)
+call_no = 0
+
+
+def save_result(result, label):
+    global call_no
+    call_no += 1
+    folder = OUT / f"{call_no:03d}_{label}"
+    result.save(str(folder))
+    for cam, frame in result.last.items():
+        safe = cam.replace(":", "_")
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f"latest_{safe}.jpg")
+    meta = result.meta
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "call": call_no,
+        "label": label,
+        "folder": str(folder),
+        "done": meta.get("done"),
+        "reason": meta.get("reason"),
+        "time_left_s": meta.get("time_left_s"),
+        "sim_time_s": meta.get("sim_time_s"),
+        "control_steps": meta.get("control_steps"),
+        "clipped": meta.get("clipped"),
+        "plan": meta.get("plan"),
+        "proprio": meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now") if isinstance(meta.get("proprio"), dict) else None,
+    }), flush=True)
+
+
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        cmd = json.loads(line)
+        op = cmd.get("op")
+        if op == "obs":
+            result = robot.get_obs(video="mp4")
+            save_result(result, "obs")
+        elif op == "watch":
+            result = robot.get_obs(seconds=float(cmd["seconds"]), video="mp4")
+            save_result(result, "watch")
+        elif op == "joint":
+            result = robot.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(cmd["actions"], dtype=np.float32),

+                                  interpolate=cmd.get("interpolate", "linear"),
+                                  video="mp4", note=cmd.get("note", "coffee station setup"))
